sources.title: Indiana Attorney General Unclaimed Property
sources.notes: Official search is free. Live search form requires Cloudflare Turnstile before result retrieval. Do not bypass; a blocked automation attempt is not evidence that no property exists.

sources.title: MissingMoney multi-state unclaimed property search
sources.notes: Indiana recommends MissingMoney for other-state searches. Current automated fetch was bot-blocked, so no negative search conclusion is allowed. State programs remain the authoritative claim sources.

sources.title: Indiana Unclaimed Property public guidance
sources.notes: Useful for claim requirements and ownership semantics, not for discovering a named property by itself.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Labor Workers Owed Wages
sources.notes: Employer-first search is public and the form itself shows no CAPTCHA. The result endpoint is JavaScript-mediated and has not yet been qualified for unattended read-only use. Claiming requires contact information, a signed WH-60, login.gov, and identity evidence.

sources.title: PBGC Find Unclaimed Retirement Benefits
sources.notes: PBGC requires last name plus last four digits of SSN for the initial match. Treat this as identity-gated; do not store SSN fragments in Git or infer them.

sources.title: FDIC Unclaimed Funds from Failed Banks
sources.notes: Public search supports name, failed institution, city, and state, but the live form requires reCAPTCHA. Do not bypass. Claiming requires an FDIC reference number and a completed claim form.

sources.title: NCUA Unclaimed Deposits
sources.notes: Current public list is directly readable. A surname/initial listing is discovery evidence only; member verification is still required before entitlement.

sources.title: Base Basenames public profile
sources.notes: Confirms the public Basename profile exists. A profile is not a monetary entitlement.
